sum: Einride AB provides digital, electric, and autonomous road freight technology solutions to shippers in Sweden, the United States, Germany, and internationally. The company offers Freight-Capacity-as-a-Service, a turn-key solution for electric and autonomous freight; and vessel-agnostic, a SaaS platform designed for customers to seamlessly integrate their own vehicles. It also provides Saga, the digital freight platform comprising transportation and charging suite to fleet operators; and the Einride Driver, an automated driving system technology solution for commercial transport, defense, and specialized civilian applications. Einride AB has a strategic collaboration agreement with NVIDIA to advance its autonomous trucking on NVIDIA hyperion. Einride AB was incorporated in 2016 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.
